author: Kelly Fraser
description: Converts a self-contained HTML design into an editable Adobe InDesign (.idml) file: live text frames, paragraph styles, linked images. First 2 pages free; $49 lifetime license for full documents.
name: idmly

tools.name: convert_to_indesign
tools.title: Convert HTML design to InDesign (.idml)
tools.description: Convert a self-contained HTML design into an editable Adobe InDesign IDML file. Provide exactly one of html (the full document as a string) or url (a public link to a hosted .html). Returns a short-lived download URL plus pages converted, fonts InDesign needs active, and a geometry check. Designs with images come back as a .zip of the .idml and a Links/ folder; unzip them together. Without a license key only the first pages convert (free trial) and the result includes the purchase link.

html.description: The complete HTML document to convert (self-contained: inline CSS, fonts via Google Fonts or embedded, images as data URIs or absolute URLs).

url.description: Public https URL of a hosted .html design (a direct link, not a share or app link).

name.description: Base name for the output file (no extension). Defaults to 'design'.

platform.description: Which platform's InDesign will open the file (picks glyph-fallback fonts). Unknown platforms get free Noto/Source Han fallbacks, so ask the user if unsure.

tools.name: idmly_status
tools.title: idmly status
tools.description: Check that the idmly engine is up and whether this connection carries a license key (presence only; the key is validated on conversion).
